meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: Decision guide for delegating to caveman-style subagents. Tells the main thread WHEN to spawn `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit), or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of doing the work inline or using vanilla `Explore`. Subagent output is caveman-compressed so the tool-result injected back into main context is ~60% smaller — main context lasts longer across long sessions. Trigger: "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", "spawn investigator/builder/reviewer", "save context", "compressed agent output".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分派编码任务给专门子代理,让长会话更持久
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在长AI对话中写代码,希望把子任务交出去以省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate coding tasks to specialized subagents to make long sessions last
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in long AI conversations and need to delegate subtasks to free up context.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按任务类型把“查代码位置”“改1-2个文件”“审查diff”分别交给三个子代理执行,它们返回压缩格式的结果,注入主对话的体积约比普通输出小六成。
howto.when: 当你提到“delegate to subagent”“use cavecrew”“save context”等关键词,或要求spawn investigator/builder/reviewer中的某个子代理时触发。

say.text: 叫 cavecrew-reviewer 审一下刚才的 diff 有没有问题。
say.note: 返回按严重度排列的问题列表。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude routes three task types — locating code, editing 1-2 files, reviewing diffs — to dedicated caveman-style subagents. Their results come back in a compressed fixed format, so the text injected into the main thread is about 60% smaller.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "delegate to subagent", "use cavecrew", or "save context", or when you ask for a specific subagent such as investigator/builder/reviewer.

say_en.text: Spawn cavecrew-investigator to find where calculateTax is defined.
Use cavecrew-builder to fix the error message at src/utils.ts:15.
say_en.note: Returns a concise edit summary or too-big.

say_en.text: Have cavecrew-reviewer check the current diff for bugs.
